INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That phone number, email or password is not correct.
WRONG_PASSWORD: Your current password is not correct.
PHONE_IN_USE: Another account already uses this phone number.
EMAIL_IN_USE: Another account already uses this email address.
CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You cannot change your own role, access or status here.
LAST_ADMIN: This is the only active admin. Make someone else an admin first.
DUPLICATE_NAME: Something with this name already exists.
DUPLICATE_PHONE: A customer with this phone number already exists.
INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Not enough bricks in stock for this.
INSUFFICIENT_MATERIAL: Not enough raw material on record for this.
OVERPAYMENT: This payment is more than the amount due.
BACKUP_TOO_LARGE: The backup is too big to email. Please download it instead.
STORAGE_FULL: Storage is full. Ask your admin to remove old photos or raise the limit.
UPDATER_UNAVAILABLE: Updates from the app are not set up on this server.
UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS: An update is already running. Wait for it to finish.
UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Could not check for the new version. Please try again in a few minutes.
UPDATE_VERSION_CHANGED: A newer version has just been released. Reload the page and try again.
ALREADY_UP_TO_DATE: This server already runs the newest version.
PIN_UNAVAILABLE: Quick sign-in is no longer set up on this device. Sign in with your phone number and password.
PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs, so quick sign-in has been removed from this device. Sign in with your phone number and password.
PIN_NOT_ALLOWED: Quick sign-in with a PIN has been turned off for your account. Ask your admin.
